name: What is the process for coordinating appliance hookups with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for coordinating appliance hookups with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation where we discuss your kitchen renovation goals and appliance selections. We then assess your current utility setup to identify any necessary upgrades or modifications for your new appliances. Next, we develop a detailed plan, coordinating with licensed electricians, plumbers, and gas fitters. We manage all scheduling, supervise the installations, and conduct final checks to ensure everything meets safety standards and local codes. Our project manager keeps you informed throughout the entire process, ensuring a smooth and stress-free experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, utility assessment, detailed planning with licensed trades, supervised installation, and final checks, with continuous client communication.
